pairs: But accept those who are weak in faith,
Alius enim credit se manducare omnia:
For one person believes that he may eat all things,
Is qui manducat, non manducantem non spernat:
He who eats should not despise him who does not eat.
et qui non manducat, manducantem non judicet:
And he who does not eat should not judge him who eats.
Tu quis es, qui judicas alienum servum?
Who are you to judge the servant of another?
He stands or falls by his own Lord.
potens est enim Deus statuere illum.
For God is able to make him stand.
Nam alius judicat diem inter diem:
For one person discerns one age from the next.
But another discerns unto every age.
Let each one increase according to his own mind.
for he gives thanks to God.
And he who does not eat,
does not eat for the Lord,
and he gives thanks to God.
For none of us lives for himself,
and none of us dies for himself.
In hoc enim Christus mortuus est,
For Christ died and rose again for this purpose:
et resurrexit: ut et mortuorum et vivorum dominetur.
that he might be the ruler of both the dead and the living.
Tu autem quid judicas fratrem tuum?
So then, why do you judge your brother?
aut tu quare spernis fratrem tuum?
Or why do you despise your brother?
omnes enim stabimus ante tribunal Christi.
For we shall all stand before the judgment seat of Christ.
every knee shall bend to me,
and every tongue shall confess to God.”
Itaque unusquisque nostrum pro se rationem reddet Deo.
And so, each one of us shall offer an explanation of himself to God.
Therefore, we should no longer judge one another.
Instead, judge this to a greater extent:
that you should not place an obstacle before your brother,
with confidence in the Lord Jesus,
that nothing is unclean in and of itself.
nisi ei qui existimat quid commune esset,
But to him who considers anything to be unclean,
Si enim propter cibum frater tuus contristatur,
For if your brother is grieved because of your food,
you are not now walking according to love.
Noli cibo tuo illum perdere, pro quo Christus mortuus est.
Do not allow your food to destroy him for whom Christ died.
Therefore, what is good for us should not be a cause of blasphemy.
Non est enim regnum Dei esca et potus: sed justitia,
For the kingdom of God is not food and drink,
et pax, et gaudium in Spiritu Sancto:
but rather justice and peace and joy, in the Holy Spirit.
qui enim in hoc servit Christo,
For he who serves Christ in this,
And so, let us pursue the things that are of peace,
et quæ ædificationis sunt, in invicem custodiamus.
and let us keep to the things that are for the edification of one another.
Noli propter escam destruere opus Dei,
Do not be willing to destroy the work of God because of food.
But there is harm for a man who offends by eating.
It is good to refrain from eating meat
neque in quo frater tuus offenditur,
and from anything by which your brother is offended,
It belongs to you, so hold it before God.
Beatus qui non judicat semetipsum in eo quod probat.
Blessed is he who does not judge himself in that by which he is tested.
quia non ex fide. Omne autem,
because it is not of faith.
quod non est ex fide, peccatum est.
For all that is not of faith is sin.
